title: {{캘리포니아로 이사!}}
text: 최근에 미국 캘리포니아로 이사하여 새로운 직업적, 개인적 기회를 탐색하고 있습니다. 이 활기찬 주가 제공하는 것들을 발견하고, 이 새로운 장에서 오는 모든 도전과 경험을 받아들이는 것이 기대됩니다. 앞으로의 여정과 황금 주에서 기다리는 모험에 대한 업데이트를 기대해 주세요!

en.title: Key {{Projects}}
en.text: Some of the most meaningful work I’ve built includes a mix of client-facing products, enterprise systems, and personal innovation projects.
list: CRM Application for SMB (Freelance) — Full Stack, 2023–2025: End-to-end MERN CRM designed from the ground up with MongoDB schema design, Node.js/Express REST APIs, React.js frontend, and secure multi-role JWT authentication with role-based access control. I independently architected, built, and deployed this client-facing system.

Wheeliyo Vehicle Marketplace — Web App, Dec 2025–Present: Vehicle buy/sell/auction platform with a bank-integrated real-time auction flow, serving 1,000+ active users. I own the end-to-end product flow and CI/CD pipeline, reducing deployment time by 66%.

Real-Time Anomaly Detection Dashboard — Dec 2024–Aug 2025: Enterprise monitoring dashboard built with live charts and async API caching, improving rendering performance by 28% and reducing manual review time by ~30%.

Kissflow No-Code Workflow Builder — Jul 2023–Aug 2024: Delivered leave management and employee management modules in a multi-step, responsive enterprise SaaS workflow UI, while reducing JavaScript bundle size by 20% through Webpack optimization.

BalaKrishnan IAS Chatbot (Freelance) — 2023–2025: AI chatbot with real-time WebSocket streaming UI and a WCAG-accessible interface, deployed end-to-end on Next.js with a Python backend and direct client collaboration from scoping to delivery.

In addition to these, I’ve also worked on smaller college projects and experimental builds, and I’m currently building AARA — an AI-powered mobile safety and wellness companion for women. AARA combines emergency SOS, GPS location sharing, voice and gesture-based safety detection, guardian alerts, and an AI companion focused on emotional and menstrual wellness.
